question: Cooper Flagg (Duke basketball, projected 2026 NBA #1 pick) maintains an On3 NIL valuation ≥ $4.0M through end of 2026-27 college season
resolution_criterion: On3 NIL Top-100 list (or successor public NIL valuation index) shows Cooper Flagg with valuation ≥ $4.0M at any quarterly snapshot between 2026-04-28 and 2027-04-15. Pre-draft NIL valuation, not NBA endorsement post-draft.
